corrections.issue: Overstates the quote: no 'Fed put' is mentioned. The speaker says the old trader mantra was 'don't fight the Fed', that a new one is 'don't fight Trump', and that Trump is 'beta dependent' (watches equity wealth levels), in parallel with the Fed being data dependent.
corrections.fix: Jackie Rosner says the old mantra 'don't fight the Fed' now has a sibling, 'don't fight Trump': the administration is transparent about its aims and 'beta dependent' (sensitive to equity market wealth levels), so large policy-driven market moves are expected.
